description: This file contains a test implementation of the IBlockPoolMonitor interface, including methods to track memory allocation and release, and a serializable class for counters used in monitoring object pool activities.

classes.name: BlockPoolMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of IBlockPoolMonitor that tracks memory operations via counters.

classes.name: ObjectPoolMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class holding counters for monitoring object pool activities.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Increments the counter for memory allocated via cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Increments the counter for memory released from cache.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Increments the report call counter with total, available, and claimed memory metrics.
